verdict.rationale: Phoenix is an LLM observability and evaluation platform. A buyer could reasonably ask whether such a platform versions and rolls back automations like scheduled evaluations or alert rules, so the axis applies. The evidence documents prompt versioning and dataset versioning, but those are adjacent features: nothing shows automations or workflows being versioned, reviewed, or rolled back.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
